title: We tried lots of products in August, these picks from Béis, Hoka, Zara and more were worth our dollars
summary: This month, our staff bought new products and tested items from brands like Adidas, Béis, Hoka, Apple and more.
story: August starts off deceptively slow for many, but it’s actually a big month of discovery for the shopping experts on our team. The laid-back nature of those first couple of weeks is often welcome following an eventful July. But just before the month comes to an end, everything seems to feel fast-paced again — students are heading back to school, people are squeezing in their last-minute summer vacations and sports fans are prepping for Premier League and football season.

At NBC Selected, we’re always in the process of testing some sort of footwear, skin care product or interesting new piece of tech — the types just vary based on the season. This August, everyone on staff tried out a mix of self-bought products and samples (sent complimentary for testing purposes) from some of our favorite brands, which includes Adidas, Shark, Zara, Béis, Phlur and many more.

Below, we’re sharing all of the products we tried out this month, including comfortable shoes, hair gel, carry-on luggage, lunch boxes, and tank tops that are so good we bought them (or would buy them) with our own money.
The best products we tried in August 2026
All of the products below are either courtesy brand samples or products that we bought ourselves.
Zoe Malin, reporter
Adidas Handball Spezial Shoes

There’s always a couple pairs of shoes that it seems like every woman in Manhattan owns, and this year, one of them is the Adidas Handball Spezial, specifically in the Earth Strata/Off White/Gum color. After weeks of seeing them at least five times a day, I convinced myself I needed them — I even started planning outfits around them in my head, so I had no choice but to buy them. I’ve been wearing them multiple times a week for a month now. The sneakers are just as stylish as I imagined, and even more comfortable than I hoped for.

They support my feet as I walk more than 20,000 steps a day in New York City, and the brown shade makes them a neutral basic that pairs well with the majority of my outfits. Two sizing notes: I went down half a size in these because I felt like they ran big when I tried them on at the store (I got a women’s 8 instead of my typical 8.5), and they’re narrow in the toe area, so if you have wide feet, they may not work for you.
Maldon Sea Salt Flakes

One of the ingredients I must have in my kitchen is Maldon Sea Salt Flakes. I sprinkle it on everything I eat to bring out the natural flavor of food and add crunch, including eggs, roasted vegetables, baked fish, pasta, ice cream and oatmeal. Whenever I run out, which I did this month, I buy the 20-ounce tub. It has a resealable lid, so it lasts me about six months;  I keep it on my counter and grab a big pinch as needed. Not to be dramatic, but the few days between when I ran out of sea salt flakes and when my new tub came were tasteless — it’s that essential to my meals.
Love Ur Curls Volumizing Foam
Love Ur Curls Strong Hold Gel

Curly hair styling is always a common theme in my TikTok algorithm, but I’ve been served even more videos about it lately, which prompted me to reconsider my routine. I consulted my hairdresser at Curl Bar Beauty, who approved of what I saw on social media and gave me more in-depth lessons based on my exact hair type.

She recommended I use a foam and a gel instead of a mousse and a cream, the latter of which weighs down my thick hair too much. I also finish with a few spritzes of my beloved Color Wow Dream Coat for Curly Hair. My hairdresser instructed me to apply these products to soaking wet hair, use a cotton T-shirt or paper towels to soak up excess moisture, air dry (or, better yet, diffuse if I have time) and break my curl cast with a little oil.

Lover Ur Curls offered to send me their Volumizing Foam and Strong Hold Gel when I was overhauling my hair styling routine. I’ve been testing them for about six weeks and truly feel like my curls have never looked as defined and shiny, or felt as soft. They also maintain their shape much better over about two days between sleeping and workouts. At $22 and $24, the foam and gel are half the price of what I was paying for similar products, so I’m less stingy about how much I use at a time, which has also contributed to my improved curl definition. Now, with a combination of the right products and a styling method I can actually commit to, I’m even more confident about my natural hair.
Local Weather Fruit Punch Premium Sports Drink

After a super hot, sweaty run, I always crave fruit punch, so I usually drink a Gatorade Zero. But when I was on vacation in Maine this month, the nearby market only had Local Weather’s Fruit Punch Premium Sport Drink — it seemed close enough to Gatorade, so I bought it. It tastes exactly like the Hawaiian Punch I had as a kid but with way less sugar and lots of electrolytes from coconut water and sea salt.

As I drank it, I started to feel much less depleted, and the flavor was delicious, so I actually enjoyed sipping it. I looked forward to buying a Local Weather each day after my run during my trip, so I ordered a 12-pack when I got home since I haven’t seen them in Manhattan grocery stores or bodegas yet.
Big Spoon Roasters Pistachio Crunch Almond Butter

I meal prep overnight oats for breakfast during the work week, and nut butter is one of my favorite toppings in addition to berries, coconut flakes and pecans. I usually go with plain almond butter, but Big Spoon Roasters sent me a few of its more unique options, and out of all the ones I tried, I came back to Pistachio Crunch Almond Butter most often. It has just enough maple and sea salt in it that I taste the flavors without them being overpowering, and the pistachios mixed with the almonds adds extra richness.
I also love spreading the Pistachio Crunch Almond Butter on rice cakes with sliced bananas before a run. I don’t think I’ll be able to go back to eating standard almond butter once I finish this jar.
Caitlin Cusack, associate social media editor
Phlur Beach Skin Shimmering Body Oil

I absolutely love when my skin looks shiny, glittery and bronzed, especially in the summer. When I saw that Phlur launched this shimmery body oil, I was beyond excited to try it out. Out of all of the glittery body oils I’ve tested (which is at least 5), I can confidently say that this one is my favorite.

The formula is extremely pigmented, so I only need to use a little bit at a time, and it’s actually noticeable to the eye and in pictures. It’s also extremely long lasting — I can put this on in the morning before lunch and get home at night with it looking fresh. My only complaint is that it’s a little sticky right after application — which is not ideal if you’re like me and always get ready super last-minute.
Béis The New Weekender

Last month, Béis dropped a fully overhauled collection of travel essentials, which included an updated version of the brand’s insanely popular OG weekender bag. We stopped by its New York City popup event to chat with founder Shay Mitchell, and I was lucky enough to take home the revamped weekender bag, which I tested out on my trip to Chicago earlier this month. I used this bag as my personal item on the flight, and was extremely impressed with how much I was able to pack — it fit all of my toiletries, hair tools, a pair of shoes and even my travel-sized Lola Blanket.

My favorite part of this bag is the soft opening, which allowed me to stuff my blanket on top of all of my things while still being able to fit the bag underneath the seat in front of me. I used the trolley sleeve to carry the bag on top of my rolling carry-on, and it made my airport experience easy.
Nespresso Iced Tumbler

I’ve been looking for a great coffee tumbler for a while, and after trying a bunch, I realized that all I wanted was to see my coffee. Not sure what the psychology behind that is, but when I found this clear iced coffee tumbler from Nespresso, I knew it was exactly what I wanted. Although it’s technically not insulated, it keeps my iced lattes cold for hours. I can make my coffee with ice at home, bring it to the office and still see ice cubes until at least noon. It’s also *actually* spill resistant. I’ve thrown this in my bag plenty of times and haven’t had an issue with spilling one time. Plus, all of the pieces are dishwasher safe, so it’s super easy to clean.
E.l.f. Hair Humidity Hero Anti-Frizz Styling Spray

As a years-long Color Wow Dream Coat fan, I was skeptical when e.l.f. launched a similar anti-frizz styling product for more than half the price. But after trying it out on a blowout, I was extremely impressed. My blowout looked shiny, silky and not frizzy at all immediately after styling, and it held up great throughout my humid commute and full day at the office.

My only complaint is that the nozzle doesn’t distribute the product that quickly, so it takes a while to cover my entire head. But, I’d take an achy wrist in exchange for a blowout that actually lasts throughout the day. And for just $9? I’m already planning to stock up before this product sells out.
Ninja AutoBarista Fully Automatic Espresso Machine

I’m a huge fan of Ninja’s OG espresso machine, the Ninja Luxe Cafe. So when the brand dropped their first fully automatic espresso machine, I was excited to try it out. After testing it over the last few weeks, I can confidently say that this machine has fixed all of my pain points that come with the Ninja Luxe Cafe.

Since it’s fully automatic, you basically don’t have to do any of the manual work you once did. This machine grinds the beans, tamps your espresso, brews your coffee and discards the grounds, all with the press of a single button. Plus, it does a full machine rinse after every single use, so I have a little peace of mind that the inside of my machine is clean. The biggest pain point is definitely the price — $900 is a lot of money, but I think it’s worth it for a machine that’s basically a personal barista living in your kitchen, especially if you’re a real coffee lover.
Marilyn La Jeunesse, newsletter editor
Phlur Vanilla Canyon

I have always been a vanilla girl. The obsession started back in middle school with Victoria’s  Secret Vanilla Lace and has been going strong ever since. Lately, I’ve been on the hunt for more mature vanilla scents that feel refined and intriguing. Phlur’s new Vanilla Canyon is just that. The scent reminds me of fall days in Southern California, the notes of wild honey and patchouli are warm and familiar. It wears well throughout the day and feels like the perfect elevated vanilla for every day wear.
Away The Bigger Flex Carry-On Suitcase

I’m a carry-on only traveler who can easily survive a two-week vacation living out of a single tiny suitcase. After my old Monos suitcase needed to be retired, I requested Away’s The Bigger Carry-On Flex to test on upcoming trips. I didn’t think the extra two inches of space would make such a difference, but I was instantly impressed when I was able to easily fit two pairs of shoes, five heavy dresses, two pairs of shorts, three shirts, my toiletry bag, and all my undergarments inside with room to spare.

This suitcase is an absolute workhorse that glides like a breeze over airport floors and other terrain. The one con is that, both times I boarded my plane, the gate agents flagged the suitcase because its height is very obvious. While I was able to put the bag in the overhead bin, anyone wanting to avoid the dreaded gatecheck may want to opt for the regular size of The Carry-On Flex.
Wet Brush x Hill House Claw Clip

As someone with androgenic alopecia and naturally thin hair, I don’t usually put my hair up. Normally, I’m very self-conscious about gaps and don’t feel like investing in claw clips or cute hair ties is really worth my money — until I got a sample of Wet Brush x Hill House’s new collaboration. For the first time in a long time, I actually wanted to wear my hair up, excited to show off all the fun patterns. While I am still insecure about the way my hair looks when it’s tied up, having cute accessories (that are surprisingly affordable) make me feel a bit more confident.
Canopy x Weezie Bath Tub Filter

Despite being a huge bath person (I take at least one steamy bath a week, even during the summer), I never knew bath tub filters existed until a colleague tested them for work. I tested the Canopy Bath Tub Filter, and was surprised at not only how easy it was to install (it took less than two minutes) and how cute it looks on my spout. There’s also a built-in temperature indicator on the side of the filter that tells you when the water is too hot — a huge bonus for anyone who tends to turn their water on full blast.
Shalwah Evans, senior editor
Adidas Tekwondo Mei

Back in May I bought a pair of these sneakers in a different color as a birthday gift to myself. They’re so comfortable that I got them in this neutral cream for that end-of-summer into fall transitional weather. The gum bottom has just the right amount of traction so that when I’m running for the train I don’t worry about slipping. I will wear these well into the winter if the weather permits — they are that stylish and easy.
Zara Ribbed Tank Top

It had been a while since I’d bought anything from Zara, but when I needed a basic tank it’s one of the first stores that came to mind — and it didn’t fail me. I love this top because it’s a neutral color but doesn’t look too simple. I can wear it with so many things in my wardrobe. Additionally, it didn’t have weird straps that were too puny to cover my bra straps (I hate fiddling with them all day) and it was fitted in a way that gave me support during that time of the month when my top is heavy and sensitive.
Yeti Rambler Jr. 12-ounce Kids Bottle

I bring my own coffee everywhere I go because I only drink one type, which means I run through coffee mugs quickly. My Yeti is by far my favorite but it’s large and I wanted something a little smaller and lighter. This kids’ rambler is the perfect size for my one cup of 6-ounce coffee, it has a leakproof top so I don’t have to worry about spills if I need to throw it in my bag during my morning commute, and it’s dishwasher safe so I just drop it in there when I get home. I also love that it has a top handle for carrying, so I can hold onto the bottle and a subway pole with the same hand.
I’ll likely never use the straw, but it doesn’t take away from the function of the bottle so I don’t mind it. I’m actually thinking about getting two more so I’ll have a Yeti for each work day.
Mili Godio, updates editor
Grace & Stella Brightening Eye Masks

We’re huge fans of Grace & Stella eye masks here at NBC Selected, and these brightening patches (which the brand launched last month) are no exception. I slap these under my eyes nearly every morning before work and they make a noticeable difference. I look so much brighter and more awake, and my genetic dark circles look a little less intense.
Ashley Morris, associate reporter, seo
Meji Meji Ko Mi Je No Rush Cycling Jersey
Meji Meji Danfo Skirt

In the past few years, Meiji Meji has become one of my favorite brands to follow, and I happened to be visiting home during its Toronto pop-up and managed to pick up a few pieces. I’m obsessed with the brand’s aesthetic, which features bold and bright colors inspired by the founder’s Nigerian roots, with stunning, unique graphics as the cornerstone of its design.

The Danfo skirt is mini without being too short (not that that’s a problem to me), and fits well. I was worried about choosing the wrong size, but the brand has a sister sizes page that shows women of different sizes in the garments, so you can get a better idea of what may work for you. I also love the fit and soft, stretchy feel of the Ko Mi Je No Rush top, which gets me compliments every time I wear it. I’ve actually had the cycling jersey since the start of the summer, but they go together perfectly.
A few months of wear has only further confirmed that I’m 100 percent on board the Meji Meji train — it’s honestly only a matter of time before I make another purchase.
Aest Studios Capture Medium Sling Bag

When Aest Studios reached out to me to send me a bag to test, I had to do a double take — never would I have imagined such a chic camera bag. It’s made from a soft yet durable washed calf leather, which has a deliciously worn-in look that’s perfect for conveying an effortless vibe. It has magnetic pockets on the side that I love to fill with my cards and lip glosses, along with a removable interior divider that keeps my camera separate from all of my other bag fillings.
Camera or not though, I’ve been carrying this bag everywhere: errands, parties, the office, you name it — yes it’s a great camera bag, but in my opinion, it’s an even better everyday bag.
Los Angeles Apparel Squareneck Top

I’ve had this top for a short while and it’s already become an essential in my wardrobe. When I initially received it from the brand, the first thing I noticed was the texture. It was soft, yet still had a firm feel to it, and best of all, was completely opaque. A non-sheer white top is hard to come by these days, and that immediately got me excited to wear it.

Since then, I’ve worn it at least twice a week, and it’s been the ideal summer top. It’s not too heavy, versatile enough to pair with just about any bottom in my wardrobe, and easy to wash and get right back to wearing (with no yellow armpits yet).
Bethany Heitman, commerce editor
State Bags Rodgers Lunch Box

My 5-year-old daughter is going into kindergarten and I’ve been focused on getting her ready with all the necessary supplies. We tested backpacks and State Bags were far and away our favorite. So, of course, I needed to buy her the matching lunchbox. The purple metallic color pleases her girlie sensibility and I like how easy it is to wipe down. I also find that when I add an ice pack, it keeps her food nice and cold all day long. Though we didn’t opt to get it personalized, the brand also offers the option for an additional fee.
Omiebox Lite

Along with the lunchbox, I got my daughter this bento-style box. It comes with a cooling gel pack that you can keep in the freezer. Then, when it’s time to pack lunch, the gel pack fits into a compartment underneath the food tray in the lunch box. The actual lunch box has three compartments for food, plus a secret surprise compartment that you can house a sweet treat or a nice note. I also like that my 5-year-old can open and close it on her own.
Hoka Kids Mach 7 Sneakers

Did I cringe at the idea of spending $100 on sneakers for my 5-year-old? Absolutely. But my daughter is super picky about her shoes and hates the thicker padded collars that many sneakers have. So when I saw that this pair has a neoprene sock-like liner, I decided to splurge. Thankfully, she loves them. I also love that she can easily pull them on herself. They have a thick, padded sole that keeps her comfy for days at the park but they’re still lightweight enough for her to run in them easily.
Dionis Goat Milk Baby Diaper Rash Cream

I’m a sucker for anything made with goat milk for my kids. After reading it was more gentle on tummies, I imported goat milk formula from Europe  for my son when he was a baby and have recently gotten into goat milk skin care products for him — including this diaper rash cream. The consistency is perfect — thick enough that it creates a barrier, but not so thick that it’s hard to spread. I’ve found that it soothes any redness he has and prevents more from popping up. I also appreciate that it is unscented, which tends to be good for a baby’s sensitive skin.
Vichy LiftActiv Collagen Specialist 16 Day Cream

Now that I’m north of 40, I’ve found that my face cream needs to work double duty — infusing moisture and ideally helping return some of its suppleness. I have been using this cream for nearly a month and find that it is rich and nourishing. It is also packed with ingredients that support firmness and smoothness and after using it consistently, I notice a genuine difference: My skin feels plumper, more hydrated and smoother.
Cory Fernandez, commerce editor
Shark FlexBreeze HydroGo Pro Portable Misting Fan

My colleague and NBC Selected editorial production associate Jem Alabi introduced me to this portable fan from Shark. I use two fans already, but it’s been extremely hot this summer, so I wanted something more powerful than what I already had, and this small, lightweight fan was the perfect solution for me.

Since it’s portable, I can charge it and then put it anywhere I want, and I’m not limited to only a few areas in my apartment. Plus, I love that it has a handle on the top and a U-shaped leg on the bottom, which allows me to position the airflow in many different angles. Also, the fan is incredibly quiet, particularly when you consider how strong it is (it has five speed settings).

There are other options out there that might be somewhat more powerful but they make more noise than the FlexBreeze HydroGo. The fan also has a compartment on the front that sprays a mist of water, making it ideal to use outside on those particularly scorching days.
Morgan Dawson, page
The Skinny Confidential Mint Ice Roller

August is my birthday month, so I decided to treat myself and splurge on this ice roller that I’ve been eyeing from The Skinny Confidential. This double-ended roller has already elevated my morning routine, and I use the smooth side for depuffing my face and the grooved side for sculpting my cheekbones and jawline. I absolutely love that the roller is aluminum so it gets cold in the freezer but doesn’t completely ice over like other rollers I’ve tried in the past. Also, I appreciate that it has caps for each end to keep the roller hygienic and contained in my jam-packed freezer.
NYT Mini Crossword Book

I have been a longtime lover of The New York Times mini crossword, but earlier this month I bought a hardcopy book of 150 mini crosswords. As a subway commuter, I’ve enjoyed doing these paper crosswords in the morning; it has been a nice way to kick off my day in a more analog way. And luckily there is an answer key in the back in case I get really stumped!
Want more from NBC Selected? Sign up for our newsletter, The Selection, and shop smarter.
Why trust NBC Selected?

I’m a commerce editor at NBC Selected, where I write about deals, sale events and more. I also test products, including home, kitchen and cleaning appliances. For this story, I got product recommendations from my colleagues. Some of the products we tested were samples sent to use by brands for testing purposes, others we bought ourselves with our own personal funds.

title: D4vd’s legal team abruptly withdraws; singer taps public defender for murder trial
summary: D4vd, whose real name is David Burke, is accused of killing Celeste Rivas, 14, whose mutilated remains were found in his Tesla.
story: LOS ANGELES — D4vd and his legal team parted ways, with the singer opting instead to be represented by public defenders in his high-profile murder case, he told a stunned courtroom Monday.

After lawyers had met with Los Angeles County Superior Court Judge Charlaine Olmedo in chambers, defense attorney Blair Berk emerged and told the court that her client, whose real name is David Burke, wants the public defender.
“Is that your wish, Mr. Burke?” Olmedo asked.
Burke responded, “Yes.”

The surprising turnaround came during what normally would have been a routine pretrial hearing in this case, in which Burke is accused of killing a 14-year-old girl, whose decaying remains were found in the trunk of his abandoned car.
Burke’s new attorney, Walid Fouad Kandeel, had been seated in the gallery until Berk disclosed the change of legal teams.
Olmedo then asked Kandeel to step forward and introduce himself to the court.
Kandeel asked for Monday’s arraignment to be continued to give him more time to study the case.
Olmedo denied the request and entered not guilty pleas on Burke’s behalf, promising to give Kandeel more time to prepare if he needed it.
Olmedo then ordered all parties to return to court Oct. 19.
Burke, shackled and wearing an orange jail jumpsuit, smiled and shook hands with his now-former attorneys Berk and Regina Peter as court was adjourned. Burke will remain in custody without bail.

“This morning the court granted our request to withdraw as counsel and appoint the Los Angeles County Public Defender’s Office after it was determined David qualified for appointed counsel,” Berk said in a statement.

“We continue to support David and his defense against these serious charges. We are grateful that the Los Angeles County Public Defender’s Office has taken over the representation and that David has a highly capable and committed team of attorneys and investigators behind him.”
The public defender’s office extended its condolences to the victim’s loved ones.

“We recognize the loss of life underlying the allegations and extend our sympathies to those who are grieving,” the office said in a statement. “At the same time, David Burke is entitled to a defense that takes his circumstances seriously and carefully examines the evidence. We are committed to providing him with that defense.”
It wasn’t immediately clear why Burke and his lawyers separated.
“I’m sure the public defender will give him a zealous representation,” District Attorney Nathan Hochman said.
Olmedo ordered Burke, 21, on July 27 to stand trial after prosecutors presented evidence at a preliminary hearing in connection with the slaying of Celeste Rivas Hernandez, 14.
Burke was arrested on the afternoon of April 16 at a house on Marmont Avenue in the Hollywood Hills, Los Angeles police said.
Police found Celeste’s remains in the trunk of a Tesla impounded at Hollywood Tow on Sept. 8. Officers were drawn to the scene after reports of a foul odor coming from the vehicle.
Text messages between Burke and Celeste say she had gotten pregnant at age 13 and had an abortion. And in an exchange in early January 2024, Burke apologized for “putting her through this.”
Madeline Morrison reported from Los Angeles and David K. Li from New York City.

title: Her son fed goats at a petting zoo. He might’ve been exposed to rabies.
summary: Three baby goats at a North Carolina petting zoo tested positive for rabies, sparking a statewide effort to track down everyone who interacted with the animals.
story: Last Friday, Rebecca Lanning got a shocking phone call: Her 4-year-old son had been exposed to rabies at a recent family outing.

Thirteen days earlier, on Aug. 15, the family had visited a dinosaur exhibit in Mocksville, North Carolina. There were food trucks, carnival games and a petting zoo, where her son fed baby goats by hand.
“I didn’t think anything of it until Friday, when his aunt called me and was like, ‘Hey, we have a situation,’” said Lanning, 30, of Marion. Lanning asked that her son not be named.

Three baby goats at the petting zoo had tested positive for rabies, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services announced Friday. The goats, along with a fourth suspected of having the disease, had been euthanized.

Lanning immediately rushed her son to the doctor, where he was given the first two of six shots of the rabies vaccine. The vaccinations are known as post-exposure prophylaxis, meaning they’re given to people after they may have been exposed to rabies to stop the virus in its tracks. Once symptoms of an infection begin, the disease — which attacks the brain and the spinal cord — is almost always fatal.
The vaccine is nearly 100% effective in preventing the disease, but only if it is given before symptoms begin.
People can be infected when they touch the saliva of or are scratched or bitten by a rabid animal.
“My fear is that if he was feeding the goats, and he’s 4, who’s to say that he didn’t touch his mouth or eyes?” Lanning said. “I don’t want to bury my child.”

It takes weeks to months after a person is exposed to rabies to develop symptoms, which can initially feel a lot like the flu: weakness, fatigue, fever and headaches. People may also develop a “prickling or itching sensation” where they were touched or bitten, according to the North Carolina health department.
The health department said Monday that it didn’t have an estimate of the number of people exposed to the infected goats.
They were at a North Carolina-based mobile petting zoo called Farm Adventures and had been featured at events across the state from July 28 through Aug. 23, the state said.
In addition to the dinosaur exhibit in Mocksville, the animals were at private events like birthday parties and a “back-to-school bash,” and they had visited an assisted living center.

A representative for Farm Adventures did not respond to a request for comment. A post on the company’s Facebook page said its goats, which were too young to be vaccinated against rabies, appeared to have been infected by a skunk that got into their pen.
Skunks, along with bats, raccoons and foxes, are typical carriers of rabies.

The state health department said in a statement that it’s “working with local health departments and healthcare systems to make sure rabies post-exposure prophylaxis is available to anyone who needs it.”

Rabies outbreaks appear to be rising across the U.S. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, 1.4 million Americans are monitored every year for possible exposure to the virus. About 100,000 people get post-exposure prophylaxis shots.

title: Vance characterizes Democratic Senate hopeful Abdul El-Sayed as ‘evil’
summary: Vice President JD Vance described Abdul El-Sayed, Michigan’s Democratic nominee for Senate, as “evil” during a campaign rally.
story: STERLING HEIGHTS, Mich. — Vice President JD Vance described Abdul El-Sayed, Michigan’s Democratic nominee for the Senate, as “evil” during a campaign rally here Monday.

“I realize that there’s something about Abdul El-Sayed that is very, very evil and on the rise in the United States of America today,” said Vance, addressing several hundred people at an event put on by MAGA Inc., a super PAC closely aligned with President Donald Trump.

“And it’s people who see themselves not as citizens of a common nation fighting for every single person — whether they’re Jewish or Christian, whether they’re white or Black or brown — but see themselves as fighting for one group at the expense of others, and that is how, ladies and gentlemen, you destroy the United States of America,” he added.

El-Sayed, who is Muslim, recently apologized for his response after an attack on a Michigan synagogue in March. In a video he posted to social media then, El-Sayed condemned the attack and added that “hurt people hurt people” — comments that critics have characterized as wrongly empathetic toward someone who violently targeted Jewish people.
“My comments may have been misconstrued to justify something I did not mean to justify,” El-Sayed said last week.

Vance referred to that episode Monday, as well as El-Sayed’s alliance with Hasan Piker, a Twitch streamer who previously said on a livestream that “America deserved 9/11.” Piker has apologized for the remark, which El-Sayed called “dumb” this month in an appearance on NBC News’ “Meet the Press” after he won the Democratic primary.
Add to Google
Add to Google

El-Sayed faces former Rep. Mike Rogers, who also spoke at Monday’s rally, in a November election that could determine partisan control of the Senate. The seat is open because Sen. Gary Peters, a Democrat, is not seeking a third term.

“When I see Abdul El-Sayed campaign around the state with somebody who said that America deserved 9/11, what I see is a man who has sympathy and compassion for people who share his religion but have nothing for people who don’t, a person who will apologize for a murderer so long as he looks the right way but will not understand the plight of an innocent child if that person has their own faith,” Vance said. “And that is the root of this terrible evil, I believe, in the United States of America that is on the rise.”

He added: “Today, you have an opportunity to speak loudly, and in November you have an opportunity to speak much more loudly against the hatred that is on the rise in the United States of America. Reject Abdul El-Sayed.”
In response to the vice president’s remarks, El-Sayed focused his criticism on both Vance and Trump.

“Evil is ripping healthcare away from working people in exchange for tax breaks for billionaires. Evil is making people pay more for groceries and gas while pushing for trade wars and actual war. Evil is dividing people for your own gain. Evil is selling out your morals for a little bit of power,” he said in a statement. “Michigan is better than being lectured to by sock puppets from Ohio and Florida.”

The MAGA Inc. event, staged in a warehouse for a local electric services contractor and tree-trimming company, featured banners that read “Protecting Americans.” It was the super PAC’s first major midterm rally to feature Vance, a likely presidential contender in 2028, as a headliner. At least one person at the event sported a red “VANCE 2028” baseball cap.

MAGA Inc. recently spent to boost Trump-endorsed Sen. Darline Graham, R-S.C., in a Senate primary runoff, but there has been skepticism in the broader GOP campaign universe about how engaged the organization will be in key races this fall.

A Republican strategist who is involved in Senate races and was granted anonymity to speak candidly doubted MAGA Inc. would spend heavily on the midterms. The strategist noted that the group has not yet spent much of its money.
“It should be called the MAGA Library Fund,” this person said. “That’s where that money is going to go, by and large.”

Vance’s visit also came amid a tense trade war between the U.S. and Canada. The clash is acutely felt in Michigan, which exports 39% of its goods to Canada, according to data compiled by the Progressive Policy Institute, a left-leaning think tank.

Vance did not mention the matter, focusing instead on the administration’s anti-fraud efforts, which he leads, and Michigan’s competitive political races. He also announced a new White House crackdown on fraudulent truck drivers — an effort Vance said is aimed at rooting out undocumented immigrants and workers who do not speak English.

Vance also advocated for Rep. John James, the Republican candidate for governor, and military veteran Mike Bouchard, the GOP nominee to succeed James in Michigan’s 10th Congressional District. James is competing with state Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson, the Democratic nominee, to succeed term-limited Democratic Gov. Gretchen Whitmer. Bouchard is running against Democrat Christina Hines, a former special victims prosecutor.
But Vance reserved his most heated rhetoric for the Senate race, in which he encouraged Michigan voters to give Rogers a chance even if they do not agree with him “100% of the time.”

In a parting shot, Vance referred to a recent social media post from El-Sayed about second lady Usha Vance. El-Sayed, playing off Vance’s remarks about his grandfather at an event in Ohio this month, mockingly wondered whether Vance would take his wife back in time to meet him.

“I actually think that the people of Michigan think it’s kind of weird when you talk about another guy’s wife,” Vance said. “But whatever you want to talk about, Abdul, keep my wife’s name the hell out of your mouth.”

title: Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift Have a Dog! And She ‘Crushed’ Her Big Debut in Ad Campaign
summary: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s dog appears with him in a new ad campaign for Tommy Hilfiger.
story: Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce and their pets are no strangers to getting a round of a-paws.
The couple’s dog is joining those ranks, making her onscreen debut alongside the Kansas City Chiefs tight end in Tommy Hilfiger’s new ad campaign, “Only in New York.”
The pooch is a Samoyed, but her name has not been made public.
The Hilfiger team had mulled over including a dog in the campaign, and Kelce thought his and Swift’s pup would be a natural.
“We figured, why not her? She crushed it, and actually really fit into that Tommy aesthetic, too,” he told Vogue. “Those are some of my favorite shots.”

In one clip, Kelce arrives to his room at New York City’s Plaza Hotel and sits with the dog on a couch, where the animal enjoys getting pet and frolics on the furniture. The pair also hang out on a couch in another clip. Kelce shared the ad to his own Instagram page and noted in the caption, “There’s also one very special cameo in there too.”
Another image from the campaign captures the dog with a paw wrapped around Kelce’s left leg, tongue out.
The campaign also stars Gigi Hadid, musicians Jisoo and Peggy Gou, and athletes Frances Tiafoe and Carmelo Anthony.
Kelce, who married Swift on July 3 at Madison Square Garden, said he was thrilled to be part of Hilfiger’s New York-set campaign.

“Tommy brought us into his world at The Plaza for this, and it doesn’t get more classic New York than that,” he said in a statement. “There’s a magic to this city, and I love that you never know who or what’s around the corner. We had a blast tapping into that unique energy with a cast who truly embody the vibes that make this city so special.”
Swift is famously the owner of three cats, Olivia Benson, Meredith Grey and Benjamin Button, who have all had their own moment in the spotlight.

Olivia, named after Mariska Hargitay’s character on “Law & Order: SVU,” appeared in a Keds commercial in 2014. (Hargitay would later name her cat Karma, in honor of Swift’s track from the “Midnight”s album.) Both Olivia and Meredith appeared in a 2018 commercial for DirecTV, and in 2023, Benjamin appeared on the cover of Time when Swift was named Person of the Year.

title: Are Melanie Moreno and Sincere Rhea From ‘Love Island USA’ Still Together Now?
summary: Are Melanie and Sincere still together after Season 8 of ‘Love Island USA’? Here’s what to know about their rocky romance and what to expect at the reunion.
story: Melanie Moreno and Sincere Rhea delivered one of the most dramatic relationships on “Love Island USA” Season 8, with their rocky romance unfolding throughout their eight weeks in Fiji.

Much like Huda Mustafa and Jeremiah Brown the season before, Melanie and Sincere became the couple viewers couldn’t stop talking about, as bombshells, broken promises and second (and third and fourth) chances repeatedly put their connection to the test.

Melanie and Sincere came in third place and left the villa with their future still uncertain. Sincere hoped for another chance and Melanie made it clear he still had more to prove outside the show. Since then, the pair have kept quiet about the status of their relationship, though public sightings together have fueled speculation that their story may not be over.
Melanie and Sincere reunited with the rest of the Season 8 cast for the “Love Island USA” reunion airing Aug. 31, where viewers may finally find out where the couple stands once and for all.
Here’s what to know about where things stand between Melanie and Sincere.
What Happened Between Melanie and Sincere on ‘Love Island USA’?

Melanie and Sincere arrived in the villa as original Islanders on Day 1 and quickly hit it off. While Melanie and Aniya Harvey both chose Sincere during the season’s first coupling, Sincere picked Melanie, and the two bonded over their shared roots in Philadelphia. But despite their immediate connection, Sincere’s interest in other women would repeatedly test their relationship throughout the season.

The first major “test” came with bombshell Sol Dean, whom Sincere continued to “explore” — namely flirting and kissing —even after assuring Melanie that he was not interested in Sol. The pattern repeated during Casa Amor, where Sincere gravitated toward Amora Robinson, sharing a bed with her, making her breakfast daily, and even telling her she “would have been the one” had she entered the villa earlier.

He ultimately returned to the villa single and chose to re-couple with Melanie, who had spent her Casa experience questioning Sincere’s intentions. Melanie also chose to re-couple with Sincere but confronted him in front of the entire villa upon his return over the disconnect between his words and his actions. “If you think I’m such a wonderful woman, then please act like it,” she said.

The tension between the pair came to a head during Movie Night, when unseen footage from the season revealed the extent of Sincere’s behavior with Sol and Amora, including moments when he had been dishonest with both Melanie and his fellow Islanders. The footage stunned the villa and left Melanie questioning what it meant for Sincere to repeatedly “choose” her after pursuing other women. “Being chosen is not a prize,” she said. “I would rather be respected. I would rather be told the truth.”

Sincere’s behavior drew scrutiny from viewers, including Melanie’s family. Melanie’s sister told her during the villa’s Family Day that Sincere was “playing” her. But in the finale, Melanie remained clear that her feelings for Sincere were real. She decided she wanted to see where their connection could go outside the villa, with the caveat that Sincere would need to continue proving himself in the real world.
Are Melanie and Sincere Still Together Now?

In an interview with Vulture from Aug. 27, Melanie said of her relationship status with Sincere, “We’re not exclusive; we’re not boyfriend-girlfriend. I’m also not in a rush to get that title. I know how he feels about me, but I think I just want to take it day by day.”

Melanie and Sincere kept quiet about the status of their relationship since leaving Fiji. In their first posts out of the villa, Melanie only included one photo of just her and Sincere and didn’t mention him in her caption. Sincere didn’t tag Melanie in his post and wrote in part, “I’m continuously working on my growth as a person and making more space to grow from my shortcomings.”
However, several public sightings fueled speculation that they may still be exploring their connection.

Photos of Melanie and Sincere together in late July first sparked reconciliation rumors, though neither has confirmed they are back together. More recently, Melanie and Sincere were spotted partying with fellow Season 8 islanders at Bryce Alakai’s DJ set in LA. Sincere was seen holding Melanie’s purse, and the pair were filmed holding hands and dancing together.
What Happened During the Reunion?
During the reunion, which was filmed on Aug. 10, Melanie and Sincere said they are not boyfriend and girlfriend, but are exclusive.
“We’re kind of just seeing what happens in the outside world,” she told Ariana Madix.
Sincere added that they are “on the same exact page.”

title: Are Bryce Alakai and Trinity Tatum From ‘Love Island USA’ Still Together Now?
summary: Long before the “Love Island USA” Season 8 finale aired, the public had already decided that the undisputed favorites in Fiji this year were Bryce Alakai and Trinity Tatum.
story: Long before the “Love Island USA” Season 8 finale aired, the public had already decided that the undisputed favorites in Fiji this year were Bryce Alakai and Trinity Tatum.
The couple started and finished their villa experience together. Despite a few bumps in the road, they were crowned the official winners of Season 8.
From meeting each other’s family to becoming an official couple, Bryce and Trinity brought viewers the exact thing viewers want from a reality show named “Love Island”: They actually fell in love.

Since leaving the villa, the pair have experienced a whirlwind. The couple appeared live on TODAY July 15, Trinity was signed by WME talent agency and Bryce’s DJ career has taken off. Clearly, winning “Love Island” was only the beginning for this star couple.

Now, Bryce and Trinity are set to reunite with their fellow Islanders for the “Love Island USA” Season 8 reunion on August 31. Here’s everything to know about their journey and where their relationship stands today.
What Happened Between Bryce and Trinity on ‘Love Island USA’?

Bryce and Trinity coupled up on Day 1 of “Love Island USA” Season 8, and while their connection earned them the fan-given ship name “Brinity,” their path to becoming the villa’s strongest couple wasn’t entirely straightforward.
The pair showed initial sparks, but both did not want to close themselves off too quickly, and they welcomed the opportunity to get to know new islanders.

Bryce and Trinity’s first major test was during the first week in Fiji, when they both elected to spend a night away from the villa at a “sleepover” where new bombshells were waiting to get to know them. Trinity got to know Gabriel Vasconcelos, while Bryce was introduced to Kayda Bosse. But neither found a new connection and returned with newfound excitement about their current couple.

But a few episodes later, Bryce wanted to make sure the door was fully closed with Kayda. He first told Trinity and his best friend Zach Georgiou, whom Kayda was coupled up with, of his intentions. The potential love square was short-lived: Kayda, also close friends with Trinity, made it clear to Bryce she only saw him as a friend.

Casa Amor presented the biggest opportunity for Bryce and Trinity to explore other options. Separated for nearly a week for the first time all summer, Bryce struggled being away from Trinity. Though he tried to get to know the new girls, he ultimately realized his heart was back at the villa. Trinity gave the experience a fair shot, getting to know Casa boy Corey Sawyer Jr., even sharing a kiss with him in the photo booth, but she decided her connection with Bryce was stronger.

The Casa re-coupling presented one of the most cinematic moments of the season: Bryce, overcome with emotion seeing Trinity waiting for him alone at the fire pit, broke out into a run and didn’t stop until he was right in front of her.

From there, Brinity only became more serious. On their first date, the couple jet-skied, drank champagne on a yacht and went snorkeling. Bryce cemented their relationship by asking Trinity to be his girlfriend.
By the finale, the relationship reached another milestone that “Love Island” fans have missed when Bryce and Trinity each said, “I love you.”
Are Bryce and Trinity Still Together After ‘Love Island USA’?

After being crowned Season 8 winners, Bryce and Trinity have spent the remainder of their summers by each others side. They’ve traveled to Los Angeles and New York City, spent a day at the beach with Bryce’s grandma and attended their first festival together.
Most recently, Bryce — who is currently on tour — performed with Ty Dolla $ign at Academy LA night club, where Trinity was joined behind the booth by many of the couple’s Season 8 friends.
Looking to the future, Trinity said on TODAY after the finale that she didn’t expect to spend much time in her home state of Virginia this summer.
“I definitely want to be wherever Bryce is, that’s for sure,” she said. “I don’t like being away from him.”
What Did Bryce and Trinity Say at the ‘Love Island USA’?
Bryce and Trinity were open with their affection for each other at the reunion.
Bryce shared that they hadn’t spent a night apart since “Love Island” ended, and that he’s gotten her into house music.
“She actually liked it,” he said of the music. “I feel like that was a huge moment for us.”
At the end of the reunion, he shut down any inquiries as to the validity of their relationship.

“I genuinely just don’t care, to be honest,” he told Andy Cohen. “Like, I love her so much and I know what she means to me and like, what I mean to her. And it’s just like, I just know how I feel and I feel like that’s good enough.”

title: Are Aniya Harvey And Carl Schmidt from ‘Love Island USA’ Still Together Now?
summary: Aniya Harvey and Carl Schmidt’s love story from Love Island Season 8 still together now? Here’s an update on their relationship.
story: Aniya Harvey and Carl Schmidt’s love story blossomed late on “Love Island USA” Season 8. Still, they were beloved enough for fans to crown them the show’s runners-up.

After meeting in Casa Amor, they almost missed their chance to be together after Aniya chose to stay loyal to her Day 1 couple, KC Chandler. Hope seemed lost when she was left single, and Carl left the villa. But the pair was saved after viewers voted for Carl and female Casa Amor bombshell Amora to return to the villa.
Aniya and Carl finally coupled up before the finale and left the show together.
They shared some updates about their relationship during the “Love Island USA” reunion, which aired on Aug. 31 and was filmed Aug. 10.
Here’s what to know about Aniya and Carl’s journey and what they’ve shared about their post-Fiji relationship so far.
What Happened Between Aniya and Carl on ‘Love Island USA’?

Aniya, one of the original cast members, had initially been coupled up with fellow OG cast member KC Chandler. However, cracks began to form over time. During the show’s infamously messy Casa Amor episodes at the middle of the season, Aniya, who began to explore a connection with Carl, a bombshell, ultimately chose KC. However, KC explored a connection with bombshell Tierra “Titi” Davis, with whom he eventually coupled up. Aniya was left single.

In a twist of fate, viewers were invited to vote for two Casa Amor bombshells — one male and one female — who hadn’t been chosen to reenter the villa. Viewers picked Carl, with whom Aniya immediately paired up with once again.

The two spent the last few weeks of the villa sharing some meaningful moments, including meeting one another’s families. During the finale, they were sent on a romantic candlelit and were surprised with a storybook that featured a custom fairytale about their journey together.
“It was always going to be you,” Carl told Aniya during their final moments alone on the show.
Are Aniya and Carl Still Together Now?

During a July 29 appearance on Bravo’s late night talk show “Watch What Happens Live,” Aniya and Carl, who were featured alongside the competition winners Trinity Tatum and Bryce Alakai, gave an update on their relationship status.

“We are not officially boyfriend girlfriend yet,” Carl told host Andy Cohen, explaining that he joined the cast during the later half of the season. “I came in late, right? I came in during Casa Amor, so, had a couple weeks to get to know each other.”
During the “WWHL” episode, Carl told Cohen that in the two weeks since the islanders have been out of the villa, his connection with Aniya “has just been really strong.”
“We just feel really, really happy,” Carl said. “We just want to kind of keep rolling that as long as we can.”
Carl and Aniya took a trip to Nantucket, with Aniya telling Access Hollywood they were looking forward to “time and peace with each other.”
She told Ebony Magazine, “We FaceTime and text each other. I feel like I learn new things about him every day. It’s such an amazing journey. I’m excited for everything, honestly.”
And in an interview with Teen Vogue, published Aug. 27, Aniya said her advice for people on the dating market is to “find you a Carl.”

“I feel like, at the end of the day, you need to find someone that you know really respects you as a person and your beliefs and your morals. Who’s going to be (there) and confide in you when you’re sad and also be with you in your happy moments. I feel like they have to see all phases of you,” she said.
She also revealed that her mom and Carl’s mom, “Ms. Nancy,” have become friends.

“I‘m telling you, my mom and Ms. Nancy, they talk to each other every day. They text each other every single day. It’s the cutest thing. I’m obsessed with it. I’m shipping that. I love their content when they post stuff together,” Aniya said.
What Happened Between Aniya and Carl on the ‘Love Island USA’ Reunion?
Aniya and Carl shared an update early on into the reunion. Sitting side-by-side, they seemed snuggled up and close.
Aniya told host Andy Cohen they were making long-distance work while she was living in Georgia and he was back in Colorado.
“We talk to each other every day,” Aniya said. “FaceTime, text each other every day.”
She said their moms talk more than they do. “They’re out hanging out right now,” she said. “They’re texting each other, calling each other.”
She then said they were planning a trip to Nantucket, which we know from social media that they took.
When Ariana Madix asked head-on if he was “handling” Aniya, he couldn’t get out an answer, seemingly embarrassed. Ariana took that as a yes.

title: ‘DWTS: The Next Pro’ Crowns It’s Winner After Dynamic and Emotional Finale
summary: During the “Dancing With the Stars: The Next Pro” finale, one dancer was crowned the winner and the new pro for Season 35 of “DWTS.”
story: There’s officially a new pro entering the “Dancing With the Stars” world.
After weeks of challenges and testing their dancing, teaching and interpersonal skills on and off the ballroom floor, one performer was named the winner of “Dancing With the Stars: The Next Pro.”
During the Aug. 31 finale, the final three contestants — Adele Zaikman, AJ Pritchard and Selena Hamilton — were tasked with a final challenge: dancing with a star.
Derek Hough returned as guest judge alongside Mark and Shirley Ballas, while Witney Carson co-hosted with Robert Irwin.

The “DWTS: The Next Pro” finale kicked off with a dynamic performance by the dance troupe, as well as Mark and Shirley dancing together. They were also joined by Derek, while Robert got a chance to once again show off his talents on the dance floor alongside his former champion partner Witney.
The opening ended with the three finalists joining the judges and hosts for a sequence worthy of a “DWTS” finale.

Kicking off the competition, which was held in front of a live audience, AJ, Adele and Selena were partnered with former “Dancing with the Stars” finalists Charli D’Amelio, Nēv Schulman and Adam Rippon, respectively, to perform two dances.

In the first round, the finalists would be able to choose their favorite ballroom or Latin style to really impress the judges. In the second round, just like on “DWTS,” they would be performing a freestyle.
What Happened During the ‘DWTS: The Next Pro’ Finale?

Selena and Adam were up first and performed a jive together. During rehearsals, the two appeared to work perfectly together, which was evident by their energy-filled performance. Mark called Selena an “electric” dancer and loved the kick, kick, Pas de Bourrée sequence. However, he did note he was left wanting more. Shirley called Selena “Miss Wow” and praised her ability to take direction, while Derek said she “commands attention” and is a star.

While rehearing AJ made sure Charlie felt comfortable in his arms while dancing the Viennese waltz. That was made evident in their performance. Mark began by praising his former partner, before complimenting AJ as a “fantastic” ballroom dancer. While there were some moments at the end that needed tweaking, he called it a “really solid performance.” Derek echoed the sentiments, applauding their trust. Shirley noted that AJ’s technique was on point but questioned if he had enough “wow moments” with Charlie.

Up next were Adele and Nēv with a samba. During rehearsals she noted that it was the “hardest” Latin ballroom style and wasn’t aware she’d be teaching someone who had never danced samba before. Nēv, on his end, was experiencing jet lag, which prompted Adele to end their first day early. However, the judges gave their routine a standing ovation with Derek calling it Nēv’s “redemption.” The judge did note that the routine needed more creativity, but the quality was there. Mark said the “Queen cobra struck again,” yet when it came to Nēv he wished he would’ve seen him go “wild, crazy” and let loose a bit more. Shirley called Adele a “magical teacher” and said “well done” to both of them.
Before the second round, the trio reflected on what led them to pursue a career in dance and what fueled their passion. Then it was freestyle time.

Selena described her routine with Adam as “gritty, contemporary fusion.” Their performance to “Cry Me a River” was met with an “oh my God” from Shirley mid-routine. After a standing ovation from the judges, Mark said he loved the dangerous opening and the various standout moments. Shirley noted that if this was on “DWTS” it would be “ranked as one of the best” routines she’s seen, calling Selena “one of a kind.” Derek, on his end, was a fan of the choreography, execution, musicality and confidence they brought to the ballroom. He said if she was on “DWTS,” she would be a “fan favorite.”

For AJ and Charlie’s final routine, he wanted to celebrate his “Next Pro” experience by including everything he learned over the last weeks. Filled with plenty of wow moments, the routine had the judges on their feet. Shirley congratulated AJ for “going big” and jam-packing the dance with a slew of epic and fun moments. Derek said the freestyle “had it all” and challenged Charlie in the best way. Mark, on his end, commended AJ on putting together a grandiose routine in such a short amount of time.

Last but not least Adele chose a paso doble “with a twist” for her and Nēv’s freestyle. Finishing strong with a standing ovation, Derek said the routine was “on fire, pun intended,” powerful and stood out from the others. Mark admired all the ballroom elements Adele incorporated, calling it “captivating.” Shirley appreciated that Adele makes her “partners work hard” and called both of her routines “excellent.”
Who Won ‘DWTS: The Next Pro’?
After eight weeks of intense competition and their two final dances, it was time to learn who would be landing the coveted “DWTS” pro spot for Season 35.
In third place was Selena, who said she didn’t think she would make it past the first week. “This is not the end,” she said, grateful for the experience and friendships.
In second place was AJ, who said he was “absolutely devastated from every being in my body,” but called his journey “enriching.”
Which meant Adele was crowned “The Next Pro.” In tears, she called this “a celebration” of all the sacrifices she’s made over the years.
What Happens Next?
Now, the new winner will get their chance to be part of “Dancing With the Stars” Season 35, which will premiere on Sept. 15.
Fans will have to wait a couple of days to find out which celebrity Adele will be paired with when the full cast is announced on Sept. 2.

title: Kelly Clarkson’s Daughter Made a Comment During Her Last Show that Brought Her to Tears
summary: “The Kelly Clarkson Show” came to an end after seven seasons, with Kelly Clarkson singing her favorite songs and bringing her kids to set.
story: After seven seasons, Studio 6A at 30 Rock wrapped the final episode of “The Kelly Clarkson Show.”

The series finale of the daytime variety talk show aired on Aug. 31. This concluding episode comes after Clarkson’s announcement in February, which pointed to her shifting focus to raising her two children, River Rose and Remy, who were in the audience and made her emotional as the show came to an end.
She first expressed gratitude for the opportunity to be welcomed into the home of millions, noting how her children have always been her priority.
“My kiddos have always come first. They’re a big reason I did this show, just the stability, the schedule,” she said. “And they’re also a big reason it’s time to say goodbye.

“I’m such a proud momma. They’re the greatest kids in the world. When we started, River was in kindergarten. She’s now about to be in middle school, crazy. My son Remington, he had his singing debut on stage with the band, little Frank Sinatra,” she continued, before showing footage of their first time on the show on Nov. 15, 2019.
Clarkson then asked her children what were their favorite moments of being on the show.
Remy shared that he liked talking to Jason Momoa and “singing ‘My Way’ with the band.”
When it came to River, she made Clarkson tear up with her response: “I like watching you shine every single day.”
As the audience “awed,” Clarkson said, “Oh no, everything is fine. That’s so sweet! OK, you got me. You just opened me on my own show. I love you, too.”
She then invited them to the stage with her, thanking the entire crew and guests that made her show possible.

“I end each episode by saying, ‘Have a great day, and if it’s not, change it.’ I say that because while we have to accept that life is totally out of our control, each moment, though, truly depends on how we choose to respond and react to it,” she said. “You don’t have to attend the negative party you were invited to. I’ve been told by a therapist, so there you go.”
“The Kelly Clarkson Show” first premiered in 2019, originally filmed in Los Angeles. Clarkson and the crew took the show to New York City in 2023 to kick off their fourth season.

From coast to coast, the “American Idol” winner’s show became known for Clarkson’s warm and honest celebrity interviews, spotlights on standout community members through human-interest segments like “Rad Human” and “Good Neighbors,” as well as games, and of course, “Kellyoke,” which opened every show on an upbeat and impressive note.
To no surprise, “Kellyoke” in particular was always a signature of Clarkson’s programming.
During the series finale, she opened with what she described as “the most requested Kellyoke” song ever: “Golden” from “KPop Demon Hunters.”

For most of the final episode, Clarkson had fans request songs from her catalogue to sing live. After hearing their stories behind why they chose one of her tracks, she sang “Since U Been Gone,” “Sober,” “Stronger,” “Piece by Piece” and “Didn’t I.”
For her final song, an audience member asked Clarkson to perform a new song. She opted to sing “I’d Be Lying” on television for the first time.

The song was originally released in July, but had not been performed live. The singer shared how the song was originally titled “If I Said I’d Do,” but her team questioned if it was for a “wedding” because of “I do.” She ultimately changed the title.
The final episode of “The Kelly Clarkson Show” will stream on Peacock Friday, Sept. 4.

title: Is Miley Cyrus Changing Her Stage Name? Website and Social Pages Hint at ‘She Just Being Miley’
summary: Miley Cyrus recently made a slight name change, which could be a hint that a new music era is on the way.
story: “My best friend Lesley said, ‘Oh, she’s just being Miley.’”
That’s a lyric from “See You Again,” the first single from Miley Cyrus’ 2007 debut album, “Meet Miley Cyrus.” Could it also be the inspiration behind her next album?

The Grammy-winning singer recently made a slight name change, which could be a hint that a new music era is on the way. She dropped her last name from her social media pages and her official website. Now, her Instagram bio and X name just say “Miley” and the url for her website has been changed to mileyofficial.com.
Plus, if you Google “Miley Cyrus,” the search engine’s results show, “Did you mean…just: miley.”
It seems the switch happened recently, as the 33-year-old posted a close-up snap with a red-and-black aesthetic on her Instagram Aug. 30 that sparked fan theories.
The next day, she shared another photo of herself with the same color theme. The caption simply read, “MILEY.”
Fans in the comments speculated that Cyrus is signaling her 10th studio album is on the way.
“MILEY IS BACK,” one fan wrote.
Another said that the colors mirrored her 2020 rock album, perhaps teasing the sound of her next record. “Giving plastic hearts era,” the Instagram user commented.
Even the official Apple Music account replied, “NEW ERA INCOMING.”
Her 10th album would follow the release of her 2025 record “Something Beautiful,” which also included a musical film. She worked on her ninth album with fiancé and music producer Maxx Morando.

The possible reference to her debut song also fits with the current nostalgic period in Cyrus’ life. Earlier this year, she celebrated the 20th anniversary of “Hannah Montana” with a television special in March. She reflected on how much the role meant to her and released  a special track titled “Younger You.”
The next chapter in Cyrus’ career will come after the death of her godmother, inspiration and music icon Dolly Parton, who died on Aug. 25 at the age of 80.
Cyrus paid tribute to her “Aunt Dolly” in a moving Instagram post.

“The feeling of losing my Aunt Dolly is beyond what feels right to share. Our most sacred moments were private and they’ll stay there behind the stage, beneath the glamour & between our hearts,” she wrote Aug. 26.

Cyrus continued, “What I KNOW is Dolly would want me to feel it, write a song about it, and then continue on and be strong. I have an angel by my side. I always have. One of our last conversations was about music and metamorphosis.”
She said she will always love Parton and will strive to make her proud. She added that her heart was breaking for the world and Parton’s family.
“We’re in this loss together and we will see her in all of the most beautiful things,” she concluded.

title: Kelly Clarkson Delivers Golden Performance of ‘Most Requested Kellyoke Ever’
summary: Kelly Clarkson went big for her final Kellyoke, saying it’s the “most requested” song: “Golden” from “KPop Demon Hunters.”
story: Kelly Clarkson went big for her final Kellyoke and per usual, it did not disappoint.
Ahead of the last episode of “The Kelly Clarkson Show” on Aug. 31, the host and singer treated fans to a rendition of the “most requested” song she’s received.
The song in question? “Golden” from the hit Netflix animated movie “KPop Demon Hunters.”
The clip begins with Clarkson belting out the first verse of the song, “I was a ghost, I was alone,” before transitioning to the Korean lyrics.
During the final episode, she shared that they taped the performance a few days prior.
The multi-Grammy winner perfectly nails the high notes and makes the song her own as her band accompanies her in the back.
The video ends with Clarkson saying, “That is a very high song.” She added, “I was like, go for it,” and made a face.
Clarkson definitely went for it and the fans loved it.
“Kelly *can do it all* Clarkson strikes again!!!!” one person commented, while another added, “Is there anything she can’t sing?”
Fans also applauded and were impressed that she sang in Korean.
“Also, as a K-pop fan, thank you for taking the time to learn the Korean and including it in the song instead of skipping over it! Amazing!!! It sounded AMAZING!!” one person wrote.
“Of course Kelly Clarkson made sure the Korean she sang was as accurate as possible for a non native speaker. Thank you!” read another person’s comment.

“The Kelly Clarkson Show” is coming to an end after seven seasons. Clarkson first announced the news in February, sharing that this decision “will allow me to prioritize my kids, which feels necessary and right for this next chapter of our lives.”
Clarkson shared 12-year-old daughter River Rose and 10-year-old son Remy with her late ex-husband Brandon Blackson, who died in August 2025.
In a TODAY interview shortly after she announced the end of her daytime talk show, Clarkson told Carson Daly why the timing felt right.

“I think everybody probably gets the timing,” she said Feb. 20. “Our family life, the dynamic changed a bit, and it has changed for a minute now. You got kids, we’ve all got kids, and it’s one of those things when you kind of start seeing life as how precious it is, too. It’s like, ‘You know what, I’m really busy.’”

Clarkson has still kept busy with her Vegas residency, as well as continued to coach on “The Voice.” She’s returning for Season 30, alongside Adam Levine and first-time coaches Riley Green and Queen Latifah, which premieres Sept. 21.

title: Why the Met Gala Just Scrapped its Controversial Theme for 2027
summary: Why did the Metropolitan Museum of Art cancel its tribute to John Galliano? Find out the controversy behind the decision.
story: The Metropolitan Museum of Art and British designer John Galliano announced Aug. 31 that “John Galliano: Horizons,” an exhibition slated to open in May 2027, will not move ahead as scheduled.
That means the Met Gala theme and dress code for 2027, which is always tied to the spring exhibition, will also not be centered around Galliano’s work.

“Following thoughtful discussions with John Galliano, we have together decided not to proceed with the exhibition,” Metropolitan Museum of Art Director and CEO Max Hollein said in a statementannouncing the news.

“After much reflection and discussion with The Met and all those involved, I have decided, with great sadness, that it is best for the exhibition not to take place at this time,” Galliano said in his own statement, also shared by the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
Anna Wintour, a museum trustee who oversees Vogue globally and organizes the Met Gala annually, also provided a statement.

“John’s decision that the exhibition devoted to his work should not take place at this time is very courageous and a measure of the man he is. I believe this is the right decision, and both he and the Museum have my full support,” Wintour said.
Here’s what to know about the decision and its preceding controversy.
Why Did the 2027 Met Gala Theme Spark Controversy?
The choice to spotlight Galliano prompted a backlash related to anti-Semitic and racist comments he made in 2010 and 2011, some of which were captured on video.

Galliano was convicted for comments targeting Jews and Asians on two separate occasions at the same Paris bar. At the time the comments were made, he served as Dior’s creative director. He was later fired.

He said in court his remarks were made due to drug and alcohol addiction. Galliano has said that he is now sober. He said his 2024 statement announcing his departure from Maison Margiela coincided with being exactly 14 years sober, per Vogue.

“It’s the worst thing I have said in my life, but I didn’t mean it,” Galliano told Vanity Fair in 2013. “I have been trying to find out why that anger was directed at this race. I now realize I was so f------ angry and so discontent with myself that I just said the most spiteful thing I could.”

According to that Vanity Fair story, “Galliano has spent the last couple of years learning about what he has to do to keep his illness at bay, facing up to what went wrong in his life, and taking certain steps to atone, including reading books on the Holocaust and Jewish history, meeting with Jewish leaders, and reaching out to members of the larger fashion community, including retailers, as part of the process of making amends and possibly returning to work.”
Speaker of the New York City Council Julie Menin blasted the decision in a letter she wrote to Wintour, Costume Institute curator Andrew Bolton and museum director Max Hollein.

“Our cultural institutions, particularly those that receive funding from the City of New York, have a responsibility to demonstrate that hatred and bigotry carry consequences,” Menin wrote in a letter shared with The New York Times. “Words matter, and whom we choose to elevate is a direct statement of our values and what we are willing to tolerate.”

Other prominent leaders from within and outside the Jewish community also criticized the exhibition, while Menin said it was “a gut punch to the Jewish community in our city, who are already reeling.”

“The Met has no tolerance for antisemitism, racism or prejudice of any kind. We are in close consultation with Jewish leaders and other stakeholders, and we take the concerns we’ve heard very seriously,” Hollein told The New York Times.
What Did the Costume Institute Say About its Decision to Change Themes?
Andrew Bolton, curator in charge of The Met’s Costume Institute, spoke to the museum’s decision in a statement.
“I believe deeply in the responsibility of museums to examine difficult histories with rigor, candor, and care,” Bolton said.

“I also recognize the pain and concern this exhibition has caused. After extensive discussion, I support the decision not to proceed. I remain deeply grateful to my colleagues and to the advisors, lenders, collaborators, and community leaders who contributed their knowledge, trust, and perspectives to the project.”

This isn’t the first time the Met Gala has highlighted a controversial figure. The 2023 gala honored the later German designer Karl Lagerfeld, whose comments on women’s bodies, the #MeToo movement and more drew renewed scrutiny.
What Did the John Galliano Say About the Costume Institute’s Decision to Change Themes?
Galliano issued a long statement on Aug. 31 referring to the “debate” around surrounding him, and how it could overshadow the actual Gala.
The statement was also shared on Instagram.

“I remain fully accountable for the pain caused by my words in the past, particularly the hurt I caused to the Jewish and Asian communities, and I remain deeply sorry for it. I understand that meaningful atonement is not achieved through an exhibition, institutional recognition or a single public gesture. It is a continuing responsibility, demonstrated through listening, learning and one’s conduct over time,” Galliano said.

“I do not want the debate surrounding me to place The Met in a difficult position or to distract from the remarkable work of the Costume Institute. I also recognise and respect that an exhibition honouring my work would be painful for some. I would also like to express my deepest gratitude to all those who have guided, supported and accompanied me throughout these fifteen years of sobriety and recovery from alcoholism and addiction. Your wisdom, patience and humanity have helped me more than I can ever adequately express.”
What Is the New Met Gala Theme?
There is no information on what the new theme will be yet.
In its statement announcing it will cancel the Galliano event, the Met said a new spring exhibition for the 2027 Met Gala “will be announced at a later date.”

title: Are Kayda Bosse and Zach Georgiou From ‘Love Island USA’ Still Together Now?
summary: Kayda Bosse and Zach Georgiou left “Love Island USA” “exclusive.” Here’s what to know about the status of their relationship ahead of the Aug. 31 reunion.
story: To date, or not to date, that is the question— the question Kayda Bosse and Zach Georgiou asked themselves at the end of “Love Island USA” Season 8, that is.

Coupled-up from Week 1, Kayda and Zach’s villa experience was more or less smooth sailing. Aside from the Casa Amor hiccup and Zach’s spat of jealousy over Caleb McDaniel wanting to chat to Kayda, the pair seemed to be happy with their connection.
The real drama emerged at the very end of their summer in Fiji, when a decision to be exclusive — but not boyfriend and girlfriend — upon leaving the villa divided the islanders.
Kayda and Zach secured fourth place in the Season 8 finale.
Ahead of the “Love Island USA” reunion, set to air on Peacock Aug. 31, here’s everything to know about where Kayda and Zach’s relationship stands today.
What Happened Between Kayda and Zach on ‘Love Island USA’?

Zach was part of the batch of original islanders, and on Day 1, he  initially coupled-up with Kenzie Annis. On Day 2, Kayda Bosse and Gabriel Vasconcelos surprised the islanders by pulling anyone who wanted to explore outside their current couple for a “sleep over.”

Kayda and Zach immediately hit it off. Though Bryce Alakai, Zach’s best friend in the villa, was also at the sleepover, he was iced out. That night, there was one giant bed for the three to share, and Kayda and Zach immediately cuddled up together and shared a kiss. When Bryce said he was going to get in on the action, Kayda replied, “You’re going to be left out. Just tonight.”
But it wasn’t just that night, and at the next re-coupling, Zach and Kayda coupled-up for the first time. The pair stayed close throughout their time in the villa.

During Casa Amor, Zach explored a connection with Alannah Keyser, before she was removed from the show on Day 19 after videos surfaced of her using a racial slur. Back at the villa, Kayda got to know Chay Nehra, but was ultimately consumed by thoughts of what Zach was getting up to at Casa Amor. After the girls received a postcard from Casa Amor which depicted Zach and Alannah kissing, Kayda was left in tears, telling Trinity in the dressing room that she felt “so stupid” for thinking Zach would stay loyal to her.

Despite the tears and second-thoughts, both Kayda and Zach went to the Casa Amor re-coupling single and stayed true to their original connection. However, Kayda was unaware that Alannah had been removed from the villa, leaving Zach with no other options. This was brought to light during Movie Night, when Kayda spotted a clip in which Alannah was missing. “Wait, where’s the angel girl?” she asked the other girls. “She left after night two,” replied Casa girl Jaiden Bacciocco, adding “I thought you knew this whole time.”
Kayda confronted Zach, pointing out he had no choice but to stay true to her after Casa Amor. Zach assured her he was always going to stay true to Kayda, and their relationship continued to progress.
Before the finale, Kayda and Zach made things official by establishing they were exclusive.
When Kayda sat down Trinity, her closest friend in the villa, to share the news, Trinity, who was officially Bryce’s girlfriend at this point, asked, “What does that mean?”
“It’s technically like dating, but we’re not boyfriend-girlfriend,” Kayda explained.

Trinity told her friend, “So, you’re in a situationship.” The comment upset Kayda, who had hoped her friend would celebrate the milestone. She received similar lukewarm reactions from the final members of Season 8’s “core four,” Aniya Harvey and Melanie Moreno.

Kayda later told Zach she wished her friends could simply be happy for her. The girls eventually cleared the air during a water park outing in Episode 31, reassuring Kayda they supported her relationship.
Kayda and Zach closed out their “Love Island” experience happily, together.
Are Kayda and Zach Still Together After ‘Love Island USA’?
Kayda and Zach finished fourth in the “Love Island USA” finale, but leaving Fiji presented a new challenge: distance. Kayda was living in New Hampshire, while Zach lived with his family in Australia.

Since then, the couple has closed that gap and made their relationship more official. Kayda shared on TikTok Aug. 19 that she was living with Zach as well as his brother, Charlie Georgiou, who appeared on Season 7 of “Love Island USA.” Kayda also officially called Zach her boyfriend.
Outside of the villa, the couple has been spotted supporting Bryce’s DJ profession as well as partying with influencers such as Tara Yummy.
